decisions.decision: Member emails to the committee are information only, with no engagement among members.
decisions.quote: announcement made regarding member emails, they should be information only and no engagement among members.

decisions.decision: Making the school and town personnel-cost information more transparent for Town Meeting attendees was set as a goal for this year.
decisions.quote: having a way to make the information more transparent for folks attending town meeting should be a goal for this year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: GASB 75 report: total OPEB liability as of 6/30/2020, trust fund balance, and resulting unfunded liability.
budget_items.quote: total opeb liability as of 6/30/2020 is $56,141,225 (mostly health benefits earned by current and retired staff).

budget_items.topic: OPEB service cost per active employee
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Service cost per eligible active employee, as presented by Odyssey Advisors.
budget_items.quote: the service cost per eligible active employee is $6,330.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Long-term return on investment the Town is assessed, discussed in answer to a question on investment options.
budget_items.quote: long term we are currently assessed 6.72% return on investment.

budget_items.topic: Retiree Medicare move and active plan discount
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A move of retirees to Medicare was reported as a cost-reduction action, leading to a discount on active plan coverage.
budget_items.quote: this led to a 2% discount for active plan coverage.

budget_items.topic: Debt service projections for building and renovation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Projected debt impact of a potential Passios building and Turkey Hill renovation, on bases of $21 million and $27 million.
budget_items.quote: the basis used was $21 million dollars, upped to $27 million for turkey hill based on when that is anticipated to start.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ambulance equipment that would otherwise have been earmarked was obtained through CARES Act funding.
budget_items.quote: some ambulance equipment that might have otherwise been earmarked but for covid has been obtained through cares act funding.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Estimated cost to train current reserve officers for certification over the next few years, from police reform requirements.
budget_items.quote: the estimated cost to get the current reserve officers trained for certification over the next few years is around $90,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: COLAs with steps expected to raise annual salary line increases in the near term because of many junior patrolmen.
budget_items.quote: colas with steps will lead to larger annual salary line increases in the near term.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Health Insurance adjustments (rate reduction and premium holiday) reviewed; reported to have significantly lowered costs for the year.
budget_items.quote: a second document reviewed the health insurance adjustments (rate reduction and month premium holiday) which significantly lowered costs for the year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager recommended a Health Insurance stabilization account to hold next year's savings for the anticipated 2023 cost spike.
budget_items.quote: she is recommending a health insurance stabilization account for holding next year's savings to support the anticipated spike in cost in 2023.
